scope: Dated source registry for the complete Netstack knowledge skill. Catalog coverage, content review, and live deployment verification are distinct.
provenance: Baseline user-supplied sources, documentation, app/contract registries and repository provenance reviewed2026-09-10; targeted original-post and price-directory additions reviewed2026-09-12. Each record retains its own evidence dates and limits.

unpublished_review.scope: Adds 33 selected original NetNetCap publications with concise summaries, original URLs, dates and individual review limits. The Quarterly Earnings Report article/status aliases are one new publication. Existing August 8 and September 8 article records and all historical release review fields are retained.
unpublished_review.review_depth: Original authored captions reviewed; full August4,August7 and August23 article texts reviewed through bounded public JSON retrieval, in addition to the previously reviewed August8 and September8 articles. September11 forecast image visually reviewed. Other linked images,videos,quoted third-party material and current deployment state are not implicitly reviewed.
unpublished_review.pricing_scope: The working address inventory includes all 35 Robinhood-labelled feed candidates in the reviewed 57-record publisher directory, plus existing ETH/USD and USDG/USD feeds. Thirty-three candidates have explicit Equity classification; SGOV/USAR do not. Six old exact token/feed mappings remain qualified and unchanged; 29 new feed records have no exact token pair or NetNet-use evidence. Four existing NET-related contracts have separate typed pricing/accounting purposes.

policies.dashboard_display_order: List netnet-monitor first in dashboard directories for presentation only. Dashboard display_order values are not evidence priority, default truth, or a primary-versus-secondary credibility ranking.
policies.evidence: Choose analytic evidence by relevance, metric definitions, provenance, observation time/block, and completeness. Reconcile conflicting claims against appropriately scoped source data, official documentation, and deployed contracts without giving directory position any evidentiary weight.
policies.freshness: Treat displayed figures as dated observations. Disclose unavailable, stale, incomplete, or differently defined data from any source.
policies.interviews: Preserve all four source posts. Do not invent titles, guests, dates, transcripts, or conclusions before reviewing the material. Attribute reviewed claims to speakers and retain recording timestamps where available.
policies.intake_completeness: Every supplied URL is retained below. A catalogued URL is not evidence that its content has been reviewed.
policies.explorer_navigation: Return RHScan links for all Robinhood Chain explorer navigation, including historical objects. Use assets/address-conventions.json explorers["4663"] templates only after validating the exact chain and full address or transaction hash; a Morpho market ID is neither. Preserve original historical retrieval URLs, dates and source attribution as evidence, never as default navigation or a fallback. Navigation is not verification; do not infer RHScan API endpoints from UI routes or transplant Blockscout paths.
policies.privacy: Do not distribute private RPC credentials, authenticated URLs, or personal portfolio notes in the portable skill.

inventory_method.sources: Retained all originally supplied URLs and updated review evidence where material was subsequently inspected; parsed every entry in the official llms.txt index; fetched all 24 documents and scanned links/address tables. inventory_method.contracts: Merged only exact chain-ID/address matches, preserving role aliases and separately recording historical generations. Used official docs tables, named public app-registry entries, local explicit registry definitions, selected provider chain-specific tables, and the user-specified Pendle JSON endpoint.
inventory_method.app_registry: Read official app HTML to discover the published module URL. Read tool returned only a truncated prefix; full static bytes were subsequently retrieved for targeted text parsing without executing downloaded JavaScript.
inventory_method.chain_verification: No live RPC, bytecode, receipt, state, owner, permission or feed verification performed. Publisher HUMAN-VERIFIED labels and local verification comments are attributed claims, not verification by this intake.
inventory_method.privacy: Public signer/operator addresses are retained separately as publisher-claimed roles, without legal-person attribution or proof of ownership/account kind. Excluded zero placeholders and user portfolio/private-history addresses. Did not copy publisher operational prose, credentials, private portfolio notes, private keys or secret names.
inventory_method.documentation_recovery: Reader-truncated tails for Superstore, COINflip, SPACEX INVADERS, MSFT Flight Simulator, TURBO and TURBO BLACKJACK were retrieved and scanned separately; no extra contract-address tables were found there.

known_discrepancies.topic: Manager bid and bought inventory versus historical exercised inventory
known_discrepancies.detail: The Manager announces a2xNAV bid and bought NET as RWB inventory; older Desk documentation describes pTEAM exercise and high-water backing minus strike remittance. Bid funding capacity, NAV definition, execution and replacement remittance mechanics are not established by the post. Retain generation-specific older accounting and do not infer a mint,burn,unlimited floor or automatic Core reserve obligation.

known_discrepancies.topic: Social Treasury and rate claims versus product-specific accounting
known_discrepancies.detail: The100M forecast image explicitly combines Treasury and Manager Sleeve; social game proceeds described as Treasury do not override documented Manager/Sleeve recipients. Promotional Credit APR and deposited/collateral figures do not establish raised depositor ceilings,current net yield or router activation. Attribute each date,unit and perimeter; do not reconcile incompatible headlines by subtraction.

known_discrepancies.topic: Direct total-return feed versus product multiplier inputs
known_discrepancies.detail: Chainlink describes total-return feeds; Credit and Board Meeting describe product multiplier use. Scoped explorer inspection matches six Credit constructor-bytecode token/feed pairs and finds MSFT/feed/adapter references in Boardroom, but product source bodies remain unavailable. The indexed Stock implementation distinguishes raw from multiplier-adjusted display balances. Do not infer a second-multiplication product formula, multiplier-only guard behavior or deployed double-counting defect; establish the product's own read interface, output units and current configuration first.
